clues: This small town in Spain lies near Madrid, the big capital city of the land.
When summer heat hits Madrid, crowds leave the city to seek cool air in the peaks near this town.
In 1808, a huge French army marched through the pass by this town as it chased a foe.
This town was wiped out in a civil war and sat on the front line for near three years. What you see now was built from scratch when the war was done.
A king once had a great road built from Madrid to the far coast, straight through the high pass by this town.
